articles.title_en: Presidential Address: Investing in Children to Address the Child Mental Health Crisis
articles.title_cn: 总统讲话：投资儿童以解决儿童心理健康危机
articles.abstract_en: The child mental health crisis has been described as the "defining public health crisis of our time." This article addresses three myths about the crisis: (i) the idea that the crisis is new; (ii) the belief that increases in youth suicide mainly reflect deterioration in children's underlying mental health; and (iii) the myth that investments in children have little impact on children's mental health. In fact, the crisis has existed for decades, youth suicides vary asynchronously with other mental health measures and are impacted by external factors such as firearms legislation, and investments can improve child mental health and prevent suicide.
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童心理健康危机被描述为“我们这个时代的决定性公共卫生危机”。本文阐述了关于这场危机的 三 神话：(i) 认为这场危机是新的； (二) 认为青少年自杀率上升主要反映了儿童潜在心理健康状况的恶化； (iii) 认为对儿童的投资对儿童的心理健康几乎没有影响的神话。事实上，这场危机已经存在了几十年，青少年自杀与其他心理健康措施不同步，并受到枪支立法等外部因素的影响，而投资可以改善儿童心理健康并预防自杀。

articles.title_en: Does Entry Remedy Collusion? Evidence from the Generic Prescription Drug Cartel
articles.title_cn: 进入可以补救共谋吗？来自非专利处方药卡特尔的证据
articles.abstract_en: Entry represents a fundamental threat to cartels. We study the extent and effect of this behavior in the largest price-fixing case in US history, which involves generic drug manufacturing. We link information on the cartel's internal operations to regulatory filings and market data. There is a substantial increase in entry after cartel formation, but regulatory approvals delay most entrants by two to four years. We estimate a structural model and simulate counterfactual equilibria. Absent entry, cartel profits would be dramatically higher. Correspondingly, reducing regulatory delays by just 1–2 years equates to consumer compensating variation of $612 million–$1.5 billion.
articles.abstract_cn: 进入对卡特尔构成根本威胁。我们研究了美国历史上最大的涉及仿制药制造的价格垄断案件中这种行为的程度和影响。我们将卡特尔内部运营的信息与监管备案和市场数据联系起来。卡特尔成立后，进入者数量大幅增加，但监管部门的批准将大多数进入者延迟了 二 至 四 年。我们估计结构模型并模拟反事实均衡。如果没有进入，卡特尔的利润将会大幅增加。相应地，将监管延迟减少 1-2 年就相当于消费者补偿 $612 百万–$1.5 十亿 的变化。

articles.title_en: The Role of People versus Places in Individual Carbon Emissions
articles.title_cn: 人与地方在个人碳排放中的作用
articles.abstract_en: There is substantial spatial heterogeneity in household carbon emissions. I leverage movers in two decades of administrative Decennial Census and American Community Survey data to estimate place effects—the amount by which carbon emissions change for the same household living in different places—for almost 1,000 cities and roughly 61,500 neighborhoods across the United States. I estimate that place effects account for 14–23 percent of overall heterogeneity. A change in neighborhood-level place effects from 1 standard deviation above the mean to 1 below would reduce household carbon emissions from residential energy and commuting by about 40 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭碳排放存在显着的空间异质性。我利用 二 几十年的行政十年一次人口普查和美国社区调查数据中的移动者来估计美国几乎 1,000 个城市和大约 61,500 个社区的地方效应，即生活在不同地方的同一家庭的碳排放量变化量。我估计地点效应解释了总体异质性的 14-23%。邻里层面的地方效应从高于均值的 1 标准差变为低于均值的 1，将减少来自住宅能源和通勤的家庭碳排放量约 40%。

articles.title_en: Efficiency in Household Decision-Making: Evidence from the Retirement Savings of US Couples
articles.title_cn: 家庭决策效率：来自美国夫妇退休储蓄的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how couples allocate retirement-saving contributions across each spouse's account. In a new dataset covering over a million US individuals, we find retirement contributions are not allocated to the account with the highest employer match rate. This lack of coordination—which goes against the assumptions of most models of household decision-making—is common, costly, persistent over time, and cannot be explained by inertia, auto-enrollment, or simple heuristics. Complementing the administrative evidence with an online survey, we find that inefficient allocations reflect both financial mistakes as well as deliberate choices, especially when trust and commitment inside the households are weak.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究夫妻如何在各自的账户上分配退休储蓄供款。在涵盖超过 百万 个美国个人的新数据集中，我们发现退休金并未分配给雇主匹配率最高的账户。这种缺乏协调的现象与大多数家庭决策模型的假设背道而驰，这种情况很常见，成本高昂，而且随着时间的推移会持续存在，并且不能用惯性、自动注册或简单的启发法来解释。通过在线调查补充行政证据，我们发现低效的分配既反映了财务错误，也反映了深思熟虑的选择，特别是当家庭内部的信任和承诺薄弱时。

articles.title_en: Changing Tracks: Human Capital Investment after Loss of Ability
articles.title_cn: 变轨：丧失能力后的人力资本投资
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first evidence on how workers invest in human capital after losing ability. Using quasi-random work accidents in Danish administrative data, we find that workers enroll in bachelor's programs after physical injuries, pursuing degrees that build on their past training and experience. Exploiting institutional differences in the stackability of degrees, we find that higher education moves injured workers from disability benefits to full-time employment, earning 25 percent more than before injury. Reskilling subsidies for injured workers pay for themselves four times over, and current rates of reskilling are substantially below the social optimum, especially for middle-aged workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供 第一 证据，说明工人在失去能力后如何投资人力资本。利用丹麦行政数据中的准随机工伤事故，我们发现工人们在身体受伤后报名参加学士学位课程，在过去的培训和经验的基础上攻读学位。利用学位可叠加性方面的制度差异，我们发现高等教育将受伤工人从残疾福利转移到全职工作，获得比受伤前更多的 25%。为受伤工人提供的再培训补贴其成本是 四 数倍，而目前的再培训率远低于社会最佳水平，尤其是对中年工人而言。

articles.abstract_en: We use public finance sufficient statistic approaches to characterize the welfare effects of "nudges," such as simplified information and warning labels, in markets with taxes and endogenous prices. While many studies focus on average effects, we show that welfare also depends on how the nudge affects the variance of choice distortions, and average effects become irrelevant with zero pass-through or optimal taxes. We implement the framework with experiments evaluating automotive fuel economy labels and sugary drink health labels. Labels decrease purchases of low-fuel economy cars and sugary drinks but may decrease welfare because they increase the variance of choice distortions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用公共财政充分的统计方法来描述“助推”的福利效应，例如在有税收和内生价格的市场中简化信息和警告标签。虽然许多研究关注平均效应，但我们表明福利还取决于助推如何影响选择扭曲的方差，并且平均效应与 零 传递或最优税收无关。我们通过评估汽车燃油经济性标签和含糖饮料健康标签的实验来实施该框架。标签减少了低燃油经济性汽车和含糖饮料的购买量，但可能会减少福利，因为它们增加了选择扭曲的方差。

articles.abstract_en: We provide a new foundation of risk aversion by showing that this attitude is fully captured by the propensity to seize insurance opportunities. In our main results, we first characterize Arrow-Pratt (1963–1964) risk aversion in terms of propensity to full insurance and the stronger notion of risk aversion of Rothschild and Stiglitz (1970) in terms of propensity to partial insurance. We then extend the analysis to comparative risk aversion by showing that the classical notion of Yaari (1969) corresponds to comparative propensity to full insurance, while the stronger notion of Ross (1981) corresponds to comparative propensity to partial insurance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过证明抓住保险机会的倾向充分体现了这种态度，从而为风险规避提供了新的基础。在我们的主要结果中，我们 第一 在全面保险倾向方面描述了 Arrow-Pratt (1963-1964) 风险厌恶，在部分保险倾向方面描述了罗斯柴尔德和斯蒂格利茨 (1970) 更强的风险厌恶概念。然后，我们将分析扩展到比较风险厌恶，表明经典的 Yaari 概念 (1969) 对应于完全保险的比较倾向，而更强的 Ross 概念 (1981) 对应于部分保险的比较倾向。

articles.abstract_en: We study one benefit to firms of selling subscriptions: the prospect that consumers will continue to pay for subscriptions they no longer value. We use comprehensive data from a large payment card network to document that months during which cards are replaced, when active renewal is required, are associated with much higher rates of cancellation. Using two stylized models of consumer inertia—driven by inattention or switching costs—we estimate that these cancellation frictions roughly double seller revenues on average, holding fixed initial subscribers. We use the estimated models to explore the impact of possible regulatory remedies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究 一 对销售订阅的公司的好处：消费者将继续为他们不再重视的订阅付费的前景。我们使用来自大型支付卡网络的综合数据来记录更换卡的月份，当需要主动续订时，取消率会高得多。使用 二 风格化的消费者惰性模型（由疏忽或转换成本驱动），我们估计这些取消摩擦使卖家平均收入大约翻倍，从而保持固定的初始订户。我们使用估计模型来探讨可能的监管补救措施的影响。

articles.title_en: How Do Mental Health Treatment Delays Impact Long-Term Mortality?
articles.title_cn: 心理健康治疗延迟如何影响长期死亡率？
articles.abstract_en: With a growing mental health crisis and a shortage of behavioral health specialists, those seeking mental health treatment often face long wait times to obtain care. I study how clinic congestion affects mortality for veterans experiencing mental health emergencies. I find that longer waiting times make it more likely that patients miss their follow-up mental health visit, consequently increasing the probability that they permanently disengage from care. A 1 standard deviation increase in wait time between the emergency department visit and follow-up appointment date (11.7 days) increases two-year mortality by about 1.5 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着心理健康危机日益严重和行为健康专家的短缺，寻求心理健康治疗的人往往面临漫长的等待时间才能获得护理。我研究诊所拥挤如何影响经历心理健康紧急情况的退伍军人的死亡率。我发现，较长的等待时间使患者更有可能错过后续的心理健康就诊，从而增加了他们永久脱离护理的可能性。急诊科就诊和随访预约日期（1 天）之间等待时间的 11.7 标准差增加会使 二 年死亡率增加约 1.5%。
